stem: Which quotation from “American Apple” best reflects an experience similar to that of the grandfather in the excerpt from Bend, Not Break: A Life in Two Worlds?

options.label: F
options.text: On a weekend I took my daughter shopping.

options.label: G
options.text: So we left the exquisite box of American apples untouched and forgot about them for a long time.

options.label: H
options.text: Not to brag about it, but as a small local newspaper reporter, the first time I saw an American apple was in an illustrated foreign magazine in our internal reference room.

options.label: J
options.text: Every night before going to bed, she would take one last look and feel the apples in her hand gently.
